DESCRIPTION:
Key Clinical Research Services Provided by PPD:

  • Early Development: Specialized services focusing on the initial phases of drug development to ensure seamless progression into clinical trials.​
  • Phase II-IV Clinical Trial Management: Expertise in managing clinical trials from proof-of-concept through post-marketing surveillance, including:​
  • Biostatistics​
  • Clinical Data Management​
  • Clinical Trial Monitoring​
  • Project Management​
  • Global Clinical Supplies​
  • Medical Writing​
  • Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics​
  • Pharmacovigilance​
  • Peri- and Post-Approval Services: Support for products nearing or having achieved regulatory approval, including real-world evidence generation and ongoing safety monitoring.​
  • Functional Service Partnerships: Customized solutions offering functional outsourcing in areas such as clinical operations, data management, and regulatory affairs.​
  • Laboratory Services: Comprehensive laboratory support encompassing:
  • Bioanalytical Lab Services
  • Biomarker Capabilities
  • Central Lab Services​
  • Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Lab Services​
  • Vaccine Sciences Lab Services​
  • Patient and Investigator Recruitment: Innovative strategies to enhance patient enrollment and site activation, ensuring timely and efficient trial execution.​
  • Regulatory Affairs: Expert guidance through the regulatory landscape to facilitate successful product approvals and market entry.​

PPD's extensive therapeutic expertise spans over 20 areas, including:​

  • Cell and Gene Therapy​
  • Critical Care​
  • Gastroenterology​
  • Dermatology​
  • Infectious Diseases​
  • Nephrology and Renal Diseases​
  • Oncology and Hematology​
  • Pediatrics
  • Respiratory​

This breadth of services and expertise positions PPD to effectively support clients in bringing life-changing therapies to market
